name: ce.memory_map
description: Page target memory regions using native single-region queries. Module filters restrict query ranges; names are resolved only for returned rows. Work stops after page lookahead or an 8192-query budget. Cursor offsets may shift if mappings change. CE's configured query backend determines region metadata; a single native call can still block. On bridge loss, stop and inspect ce.status before retrying.

moduleFilter.description: Matches module names; query only merged matching module ranges rather than enumerate the full target address space.

limit.description: Bounds returned rows, not inspected regions. Filters and cursor skipping may require more queries, capped at 8192; individual native calls have no latency guarantee.
